parameters.query:
SELECT coalesce(string_agg(title, E'\n'), '') AS titles
FROM (SELECT title FROM ryzh_topics ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 80) t;

INSERT INTO ryzh_topics (title, rubric, angle, facts, note, source_url, score, status)
SELECT x.title, x.rubric, x.angle, x.facts, x.note, x.source_url, x.score, 'proposed'
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(title text, rubric text, angle text, facts text,
                                         note text, source_url text, score real)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ryzh_topics t WHERE t.source_url = x.source_url)
RETURNING id;
